title: Enterprise Business Intelligence Dashboard Modernization
raw_description: The City of Vancouver is modernizing its enterprise reporting infrastructure. The project requires migration from legacy Crystal Reports to a modern BI platform (Power BI or Tableau), development of 40+ operational dashboards for city departments, implementation of a self-service analytics layer, and staff training. The vendor should have demonstrated experience with municipal data, public-sector procurement compliance, and multi-stakeholder project delivery. Integration with SAP financials and Salesforce CRM is required. Deliverables include a BI architecture blueprint, data catalogue, and governance policy.

ground_truth.rationale: Strong match — Power BI, Tableau, data governance, and self-service analytics align directly with Your Organization core capabilities. City of Vancouver is a high-value BC municipal client. $400K in target range.
